tier1.headline: Your data trains AI
tier1.quote: Our client applications automatically collect anonymous information about your endpoint (application version, device hardware specifications and network performance statistics) to enhance our products and services quality.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account
tier1.quote: When you browse our websites, we may collect information about your visit to our websites, your usage of the Services, and your web browsing.

tier2.headline: Your data shared within company
tier2.quote: TrueConf may share your information as follows: TrueConf’s subsidiaries in accordance with our business purposes.

tier2.headline: Your data retained for years
tier2.quote: For personal data related to your specific use of our products and services our stated policy is to retain that data for 2 years.

tier2.headline: Your IP address is collected
tier2.quote: That information may include your IP address, your operating system, your browser, language, device, and other information.

tier2.headline: Your behavior helps tailor site
tier2.quote: We use cookies to allow us to understand what areas of the site are of interest to you so we can better serve and provide you with tailored information from the site.

tier2.headline: Your data stored in Germany
tier2.quote: Electronic information collected by TrueConf’s website for European users (trueconf.com) is kept on the servers that are owned and operated by TrueConf LLC.

tier2.headline: Your data shared for legal process
tier2.quote: We will disclose information when we believe such action is necessary or desirable to respond to legal process or government demands or requests, to protect lives or property rights, to maintain the security of our products or services, or to help defend ourselves against any claims or allegations.

tier2.headline: Your transactional emails are kept
tier2.quote: Transactional emails containing your license or billing information do not have an unsubscribe link by default, since it will not be possible to keep providing you with our services.
